Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment on MAP & legal sequencing for Aurora Biotech (MSA/DPA/order form)

Elaine — thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, attaching a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that maps evaluation milestones to procurement/legal checkpoints so we can hit a target signature window. High level ask below; MAP attached.

Quick summary / proposals:
- Goal: Signed MSA + DPA + executed order form by ~June 18, 2026 (we can compress if legal/procurement parallelizes).
- Preferred flow: run MSA and DPA review in parallel to avoid serial delays; final order form executed once pricing and procurement approvals are confirmed.
- Key milestones (proposed):
  • Tech eval & pilot acceptance: complete by May 28
  • Security evidence (SOC2 summary, audit logs): deliver by May 21 (we can share test evidence earlier)
  • Legal redlines returned: target May 24
  • Contract alignment (MSA/DPA): target mutual signoff Jun 4
  • Order form execution: target Jun 18

Action items for Aurora: please confirm the legal reviewer(s) + procurement approver(s) and any must-have DPA clauses (data residency, subprocessor list). If you want, we can provide a redline-ready PDF of our standard MSA/DPA today.

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel, 28KB)

Thanks — I can host a short working session this week to walk the MAP with procurement/legal.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0119
From: Elaine Park <elaine@aurora.bio>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aurora.bio>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alignment on MAP & legal sequencing for Aurora Biotech (MSA/DPA/order form)

Karthik — thanks for the MAP and the clear milestones. A few clarifying notes from procurement/legal side:

- Procurement contacts: Elaine Park (me, procurement lead), Bethany Liu (approver, procurement@aurora.bio).
- Legal reviewer: External counsel is Gordon Myers (g.myers@myerslaw.com); our in-house counsel, Samantha Ortiz, will do final sign-off.
- Required DPA items: data residency in US; right to audit (limited); minimum breach notification window = 48 hours.
- Security evidence: we need SOC2 Type II summary + recent penetration test report. If you can surface KV-cache & retention details in the MAP, that would help our privacy folks.

On sequencing: procurement prefers parallel review of MSA and DPA, but our legal counsel typically wants to see final MSA wording before we lock order-of-operations for the order form (pricing contingent approvals). If you can accept parallel redlines and provide a short canary clause to allow order-form execution with conditional SOW language, we can probably compress dates.

Target: procurement would be comfortable with a June 25 signature if all evidence & redlines arrive by May 24. Can your team accelerate the SOC2 summary and a redline-ready MSA PDF?

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Procurement Lead, Aurora Biotech
elaine@aurora.bio | +1 617-555-0210

Elaine — appreciate the clarity. We can support parallel reviews and will provide the SOC2 summary + pen test overview today. I attached a redline-ready PDF with our standard MSA/DPA and a suggested conditional order-form clause that lets procurement draft an order pending final pricing confirmation (DocuSign step after pricing lock).

Updated, agreed-upon milestone plan (adjusted after your note):
- May 14: Redwood shares MSA/DPA redline-ready PDF + SOC2 summary + pen test overview. (attached)
- May 21: Aurora privacy/security team confirms DPA must-haves or flags exceptions
- May 24: Aurora legal returns redlines to Redwood (target)
- May 28: Technical evaluation & pilot acceptance window closes
- Jun 04: Contract alignment (MSA/DPA) — mutual signoff target (parallel reviews complete)
- Jun 18: Order form execution (finalized pricing and procurement approvals) — target

If Aurora can return redlines by the 24th we’ll prep the DocuSign envelope the same week and queue the order form template (pre-filled with the agreed pricing table). For transparency: if an exceptional clause is requested (e.g., permanent data residency outside US), that will require a short SSO/ops design call before final order.

Attachment: Redlines_Aurora_20260514.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

Next steps I can take on our side:
- schedule a 30-min working session with your legal + procurement for Fri May 15 10am PT (I’ll propose on calendar)
- provide the SSO/data residency FAQ and evidence pack to Samantha & Gordon

— Karthik
